subject: Residential and Senior Property Tax Exemptions
overview: The committee met with the Interim Chief Assessor to evaluate the potential implementation of residential and senior property tax exemptions. Members requested further analysis on fiscal impacts to renters and city staffing before placing the matters on file.

items.title: Residential and Senior Tax Exemptions
items.summary: Placed on file after requesting written reports on the fiscal and social impacts of adopting property tax exemptions for seniors and owner-occupied residences. Interim Chief Assessor Ellen Brideau presented scenarios for shifting the tax burden from moderately valued homes to higher-value and non-owner-occupied properties, leading to council debate regarding potential rent increases for tenants.
